post.title: My AI rockets crashed for 5 generations. Gen 13: 57 landed
post.caption: My AI rockets crashed every time for 5 generations. Gen 6: the first one landed. Gen 7: 8. Gen 8: 37. Gen 13: 57. Each rocket is a small neural network that fires its thrusters; the best landers get copied with mutations.
post.pinned: Each rocket is a small neural network that controls its thrusters. No one tells it how to land. The best ones get copied with random mutations into the next generation.
post.notes: Extra reel (Ansh asked for more, Nov 25). Seed 4089. landed by gen: 0,0,0,0,0,1,8,37,38,39,37,43,57. Idea test: relatable/question/unrealistic = 2 to 3 of 4.
